module.purpose: Provides the configureStore API, a user-friendly wrapper around Redux's createStore that sets up reducers, middleware, DevTools, and enhancers with sane defaults for Redux Toolkit.
module.summary: This module exports a configureStore function that abstracts the boilerplate of creating a Redux store. It accepts an options object specifying reducer(s), middleware, devTools, preloadedState, and enhancers. The function normalizes the reducer (function or combined object), builds default middleware, validates inputs in development, optionally integrates the Redux DevTools Extension, checks for duplicate middleware, and composes enhancers before returning a created store. It is the primary store-creation entry point in Redux Toolkit.
module.businessContext: Redux state management for JS apps. If this fails, applications cannot initialize their central store, breaking all state-driven UI.
